description: Three sine oscillators at the corners of a triangle, each able to modulate the phase and the amplitude of the others, with a delayed feedback path on every one

params.text: Sets the pitch of all three oscillators together, in octaves from -9 to +9 either side of C4
Offsets the Good oscillator from the shared pitch, in octaves from -9 to +9
Offsets the Bad oscillator from the shared pitch, in octaves from -9 to +9
Offsets the Ugly oscillator from the shared pitch, in octaves from -9 to +9
Sets how much of the Good oscillator reaches the MIX output; the GOOD output is not affected by it
Sets how much of the Bad oscillator reaches the MIX output; the BAD output is not affected by it
Sets how much of the Ugly oscillator reaches the MIX output; the UGLY output is not affected by it
Sets how much of the Good oscillator's own delayed output is fed back into its phase
Sets how much of the Bad oscillator's own delayed output is fed back into its phase
Sets how much of the Ugly oscillator's own delayed output is fed back into its phase
Sets how much the Good oscillator modulates the phase of the Bad oscillator
Sets how much the Bad oscillator modulates the phase of the Good oscillator
Sets how much the Ugly oscillator modulates the phase of the Good oscillator
Sets how much the Ugly oscillator modulates the phase of the Bad oscillator
Sets the amplitude modulation between the Good and the Bad and which way it runs: turned right the Good modulates the Bad, turned left the Bad modulates the Good, centred there is none
Sets how much the Ugly oscillator modulates the amplitude of the Good oscillator
Sets how much the Ugly oscillator modulates the amplitude of the Bad oscillator
Sets what the amplitude modulation does: fully left it is ring modulation, which flips the carrier over on the modulator's negative half, and fully right it only ducks the carrier
Attenuverts the RM / AM input before it is added to the RM / AM knob
Sets how far back in the feedback buffer every oscillator reads its own output, from one sample fully left to 4096 samples fully right
Attenuverts the feedback delay input before it is added to the feedback delay knob
Sets how fast the Ugly oscillator's pitch wanders
Sets how far the Ugly oscillator's pitch wanders from the pitch it is heading for
Sets how hard the Ugly oscillator's pitch is pulled towards the pitch its knob and jack ask for
Damps the Ugly oscillator's pitch movement, so a low setting lets it overshoot and swing past its target
Chooses what the Ugly oscillator is made of: Ugly is one oscillator, Weird adds a second that modulates the first, and Queen is two oscillators detuned a little and summed

inputs.text: Volt-per-octave pitch for the Good oscillator; the number of polyphonic voices the whole module runs is taken from this jack
Volt-per-octave pitch for the Bad oscillator, reading the Good oscillator's pitch jack when nothing is patched here
Volt-per-octave pitch for the Ugly oscillator, reading the Good oscillator's pitch jack when nothing is patched here
Scales the Good oscillator's level, 10V giving the whole of what the knob beside it allows and 0V silence
Scales the Bad oscillator's level, 10V giving the whole of what the knob beside it allows and 0V silence
Scales the Ugly oscillator's level, 10V giving the whole of what the knob beside it allows and 0V silence
Scales the Good oscillator's feedback, 10V giving the whole of what the knob beside it allows and 0V none
Scales the Bad oscillator's feedback, 10V giving the whole of what the knob beside it allows and 0V none
Scales the Ugly oscillator's feedback, 10V giving the whole of what the knob beside it allows and 0V none
Scales the phase modulation of the Bad oscillator by the Good, 10V giving the whole of what its knob allows and 0V none
Scales the phase modulation of the Good oscillator by the Bad, 10V giving the whole of what its knob allows and 0V none
Scales the phase modulation of the Good oscillator by the Ugly, 10V giving the whole of what its knob allows and 0V none
Scales the phase modulation of the Bad oscillator by the Ugly, 10V giving the whole of what its knob allows and 0V none
Scales the amplitude modulation between the Good and the Bad, 10V giving the whole of what its knob allows and 0V none
Scales the amplitude modulation of the Good oscillator by the Ugly, 10V giving the whole of what its knob allows and 0V none
Scales the amplitude modulation of the Bad oscillator by the Ugly, 10V giving the whole of what its knob allows and 0V none
Shifts the ring-to-amplitude mix, 5V covering the whole of the RM / AM knob's travel at full attenuverter; the total is held between the two ends
Shifts the feedback delay, 5V covering the whole of the feedback delay knob's travel at full attenuverter; the total is held between the two ends

outputs.text: The Good oscillator on its own, ±5V, at full level whatever its LVL knob is set to
The Bad oscillator on its own, ±5V, at full level whatever its LVL knob is set to
The Ugly oscillator on its own, ±5V, at full level whatever its LVL knob is set to
The three oscillators added in the proportions the LVL knobs set, ±5V
How far the Ugly oscillator's pitch is from the pitch it is heading for, in volts; a modulation signal rather than audio

notes: the number of polyphonic voices is taken from the Good oscillator's V/OCT jack, and all five outputs carry that many.
a modulation jack scales the knob beside it rather than adding to it, so an unpatched knob sets the amount outright while a patched one sets the most 10V can reach.
a modulation jack left patched but resting at 0V therefore gives no modulation at all, whatever its knob is set to.
the panel prints AM on the three cross-modulation knobs where the maker's tooltips call them RM; the RM / AM knob sets which of the two they do.
